what: A hidden image (white wing band · photo) is revealed from left to right, dragging a smeared edge along. A 300%-wide horizontal mask (0~46% visible · 52% edge · 58%~ hidden) is pushed from 100% to 0% over 2.4s power4.inOut, while the edge intensity settles from 1 to .22 over 1.4s power2.out, so it starts razor-sharp and the trail left behind blurs faintly. Plays once when it reaches 80% of the screen, or every time it receives fx:sweep

options.edge: Edge darkness after everything has passed, default .22
options.edge-dur: Time for the edge to settle (sec), default 1.4 (first section 1)
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top 80% — if manual, only when it receives fx:sweep
options.fx:sweep: Fire it at an element to hide it, then reveal it again (used by the section-turn driver)

note: --fx-edge is interpolated as a number via @property. Without ScrollTrigger it runs once right after pinning

from.where: index.js openBand (.j-band — white wing band hanging below each section, .4s late after the turn, 2.4s power4.inOut · first section 2.8s)
